text:
peter: Heads-up  bringing up customer Mistral's patchwork adapter (merge #821) into staging. Adapter layout: patch_blocks + tokenmap=mistralmap1. Quickpack covers invoice ids, decimals, percent signs, and postcode formats. Will run int4 pcq (per-channel quant) smoke + int8-hybrid for control. Posting failures here.

asha: Got it. Does patch_blocks reorder special tokens or add new fused tokens? Need to know if loader alias or conversion needed.

peter: patch_blocks added fused tokens for percent and currency (e.g., "%5" -> single token). That was intentional for perf, but it collides with baseline splitting for many locale formats. No conversion script shipped.

lia: Ran 300-sample quickpack on mistral-patch:v1 int4 (pcq). Topline: percent extraction F1 down 2.2pts, amounts decimal collapse in ~14 examples. Example: 
```
input: "Discount: 7.5%"
baseline: "7.5 percent"
mistral-int4-pcq: "75 percent"
```
And: 
```
input: "Total: $2.40"
baseline: "2.40 USD"
mistral: "240 USD"
```
Looks like fused token decode removing separators.

peter: Ack. Try re-running with --no-fast-bpe and adapter-alias=true. Also run int8-hybrid + gptq group 64 for comparison. CLI we use: 
```
r-infer eval --model mistral-patch:v1 --quant int4-pcq --prompts quickpack_money.json --no-fast-bpe --adapter-alias --out /tmp/mistral_pcq.json
```

ops-bot: Canary created for mistral-patch:v1 -> id 99001. 6k tokens queued, p50 70ms. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/99001

lia: Re-ran with adapter-alias + no-fast-bpe. Percent issue largely improved, amounts decimals better but spacing glued in several cases ("2.40USD"). int8-hybrid kept spacing intact.

tok-bot: token-diff requested between base_tok and mistralmap1 -> running tools/token_diff.py, output will land in artifacts.

asha: If fused tokens are the cause we have 2 paths: (1) tiny alias mapping to split common fused tokens like "%5" -> "%" + "5", or (2) prefer conversion at build time to avoid runtime alias. For now prototype alias to unblock canary.

lia: Uploaded failure CSV and top 20 examples to artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/mistral/99001/failures.csv

ops-bot: Canary 99001 update: after alias patch errors dropped from 0.95% -> 0.28%. p50 72ms. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/mistral/99001

peter: Good. Next steps: @asha make minimal alias for fused percent/currency tokens and add tokenizer unit tests; @lia schedule quant-resweep (int4-pcq group size 64 -> 32, int8-hybrid) and add quickpack_money to long-term regressions (mistral-reg-v1). If alias closes >80% we'll consider baking alias into patch_blocks loader.

asha: Will prototype alias and push to staging. Also adding a post-process rule to ensure currency-spacing as short-term safety-net.

lia: One more note: a couple UK date formats still parse mm/dd. Isolate date prompts and I'll check whether it's tokenizer remap or model-level bias.

peter: Assigning owners: @peter (owner), @asha (tokenizer), @lia (eval). Re-open thread if regressions reappear after wider canary. :eyes:
